name: Largest Public Real-World Conversational Recommendation Dataset
description: A new dataset of recommendation-related conversations scraped from a popular discussion website, designed to study conversational recommendation tasks in zero-shot settings with large language models.
reputation: A niche dataset for conversational recommendation research with limited evidence of broad benchmark adoption outside the original work.
notes: Largest public real-world conversational recommendation dataset to date; used for zero-shot evaluation of LLMs.
